name: default
description: Default dashboard layout. Used when no --template flag is provided.

sections.title: Dataset Overview
sections.description: High-level narrative about the dataset: what it contains, how many rows and columns, and general data quality.

sections.title: Schema & Column Types
sections.description: Table listing each column name, inferred data type, null count, and unique value count.

sections.title: Descriptive Statistics
sections.description: Full-data descriptive stats for numeric columns: count, mean, std, min, 25%, 50%, 75%, max.

sections.title: Missing Values
sections.description: Bar or heatmap showing null percentage per column. Skipped if dataset has no nulls.

sections.title: Distributions
sections.description: Histogram or bar chart for each column. Numeric columns get histograms, categorical columns get bar charts.

sections.title: Correlation Matrix
sections.description: Heatmap of Pearson or Spearman correlation between numeric columns. Skipped if fewer than 2 numeric columns.

sections.title: Outliers
sections.description: Boxplot per numeric column to surface outliers detected via IQR. Skipped if no outliers found.

sections.title: Time Series
sections.description: Line charts for numeric columns plotted against detected date columns. Skipped if no date column is found.

sections.title: Additional Charts
sections.description: Any extra charts the Viz Agent selects based on data characteristics (scatter, pie, violin, pairplot, etc.).

sections.title: Key Insights
sections.description: Narrative summary of the most important findings: trends, anomalies, dominant categories, notable correlations.

sections.title: Recommendations
sections.description: Optional next steps suggested by the Report Agent based on the insights (e.g. further analysis, data cleaning, modeling ideas).
